name: coc_event_dispatch

ownership.argument: This gives the event numbers a p67 module must switch on: 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 12, 13, 14. What each number MEANS is not proven - that stays a hole - but the set itself and the work-node flag of 1 are measured. The data pointer is freed by the handler, so the module receives ownership of it.

provenance.source: A registered PSM handler: switches on the event number and posts a work item (flag 1) with the data pointer for events 1, 2, 3, 6, 7, 8, 12, 13 and 14, and handles event 5 inline (it zeroes the u16 at data+4 and calls 0xC805C98). A second handler registered for PSM 1 (0xC806AC8) switches on 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, a subset, so the numbering is a stack-wide enum rather than per-PSM.
